_comment: Weave preset - methodology gate. Advisory (FLAG/NOTIFY): hard invariants live in lifecycle, access in RBAC. These are the soft nudges Weave's process depends on: confirm reuse before a new module, require rationale on an ADR, and route risky task types to human approval (the opt-in per-task gate). Concepts are verb/noun-focused so they don't collide under static embeddings.
dsl:
rule "new module - confirm reuse" priority 20
when
    sim(relation_type, "MODULE_CREATION") > 0.4
then
    flag("New module proposed - query Weave first to confirm no existing module already covers it (check owns / depends_on), then proceed.")
end

rule "risky change needs human sign-off" priority 18
when
    sim(decision_trace, "RISKY_CHANGE") > 0.42
then
    flag("Risky change (schema / infra / security / breaking) - route to a human for approval before merge.")
end

rule "architecture decision needs rationale" priority 15
when
    sim(relation_type, "ARCHITECTURE") > 0.4
    and evidence_count < 1
then
    notify("Architecture decision recorded without supporting evidence - add the rationale (the WHY, and any rejected option).")
end

rule "low-confidence capture needs confirmation" priority 10
when
    confidence < 0.5
then
    flag("Low-confidence auto-captured decision - a role should confirm it.")
end
